main.description: The period during which the post content is valid as a description of the situation or as an instruction. Distinct from the mesh delivery deadline. An omitted endpoint is unknown; do not infer it from delivery deadlines or receipt times.

from.description: Start of validity. UTC with an uppercase Z suffix; preserve the original string. Omit when unknown.

until.description: End of validity. UTC with an uppercase Z suffix; preserve the original string. Omit when unknown. Expiry does not delete or retract the post.
